scenes.title: After the Battle
scenes.rationale: The immediate aftermath, captive handling, and debrief with Havdar form one post-battle recovery situation.
scenes.overview: The party binds the captive, examines the orc emblem, and learns how four of Havdar’s warriors died.
scenes.transitionToNext: Aram revives the prisoner for questioning.

scenes.title: Gorkil and the Blighted One
scenes.rationale: The first questions, private sidebar, resumed interrogation, and report to Havdar all concern the same captive and the meaning of his revelations.
scenes.overview: Gorkil boasts of Grash and attacks on peaceful orcs; after a private debate, Seeker is compelled to kill him.
scenes.transitionToNext: Havdar calls the group to the funeral.

scenes.title: Honoring the Fallen
scenes.rationale: The funeral, memorial gift, spear trade, evening practice, and shared meal form the camp’s response to its losses before the overnight rest.
scenes.overview: The party mourns the dead; Wellby receives Camana’s bowstring, Kenzo trades for a jumping ring, and they practice together.
scenes.transitionToNext: Morning brings returning scouts and a decision about the journey.

scenes.title: The Southern Detour
scenes.rationale: The scouts’ report, choice of the monastery, desert journey, and river camp form one continuous decision and approach, with the southern trees considered but not pursued.
scenes.overview: After hearing the scouts’ report, the party chooses the monastery and takes a wide southern detour to the dry Kharja.
scenes.transitionToNext: After the river camp, they turn north toward Kharsan.

scenes.title: Kharsan Through a Hawk’s Eyes
scenes.rationale: The northward approach, first view, and aerial survey share one reconnaissance goal before any entry into the ruins.
scenes.overview: Wellby scouts the city, royal tombs, orc fort, and intact monastery through a hawk, finding a sheltered approach.
